decks.notes: This Dimir Control deck focuses on maintaining board control through a combination of counter spells, removal spells, and card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt opponents' strategies with cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek, while also utilizing counterspells like Force of Negation and Counterspell to protect its own threats. By utilizing efficient card draw with Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and filtering with Preordain, the deck aims to outvalue opponents and grind them out in a long game. Murktide Regent provides a strong threat to close out the game once control has been established.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, and Territorial Kavu, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding provide support by boosting the power of the creatures, while Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames help deal direct damage to the opponent. The deck also includes some control elements like Stubborn Denial to protect its creatures and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker for card advantage.

The deck focuses on efficiently ramping up mana with land cards such as Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field to quickly cast Primeval Titan. The key strategy involves using Amulet of Vigor to untap lands for additional activations, allowing for explosive plays like Scapeshift to search for multiple lands and deal significant damage. The deck also utilizes cards like Urza's Saga and Aftermath Analyst to generate additional value and card advantage. Overall, the goal is to assemble powerful combinations of lands and spells to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively with a mix of discard spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The key strategy is to control the game early with cards like Fatal Push and Thought-Knot Seer, then finish the opponent off with powerful creatures like Emperor of Bones and Nethergoyf. The deck also utilizes Eldrazi Temple to ramp out big threats ahead of schedule. The inclusion of Urza's Saga helps to provide additional threats and utility in the form of tokens and artifacts.

This Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying powerful creatures like Scion of Draco and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, supported by cards like Tribal Flames and Lightning Bolt for additional damage. Leyline of the Guildpact helps to boost the strength of multicolored creatures, while Leyline Binding can control opponent's threats. The deck also includes some counterplay tools like Stubborn Denial and Consign to Memory. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's multicolored requirements, allowing for consistent and aggressive plays in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana to cast Primeval Titan and search for powerful lands such as Boseiju, Who Endures and Urza's Saga. By utilizing cards like Amulet of Vigor and Arboreal Grazer, the deck is able to generate an enormous amount of mana and cast game-winning spells like Scapeshift. The key strategy is to assemble the right combination of lands and spells to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and game-changing effects. The deck is all about efficiently utilizing resources to execute a powerful combo and win the game swiftly.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the synergy between Basking Broodscale and Blade of the Bloodchief to generate a large number of tokens and buff them up. This combo is supported by cards like Glaring Fleshraker and Kozilek's Command to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes cards like Eldrazi Temple and Ancient Stirrings to quickly ramp up and find key pieces. The end game plan is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and close out the game with a massive board presence.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble a combo without relying on traditional lands. By utilizing cards like Lotus Bloom and Whir of Invention, the deck aims to achieve a game-winning play through a combination of spells and abilities. Thundertrap Trainer and Tameshi, Reality Architect are key components in setting up the combo, while cards like Sea Gate Restoration and Hydroelectric Specimen provide additional support. The deck also includes disruption and protection spells like Spell Snare and Force of Negation to ensure the combo goes off successfully. Ultimately, the goal is to win the game using cards like Goblin Charbelcher.

This combo deck utilizes Allosaurus Rider and Neoform to search for and play Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant as early as turn two, creating a powerful and explosive board presence. The deck also includes other utility creatures such as Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to provide additional value and support the combo strategy. Glittering Wish allows for versatile sideboard options to combat different matchups, while Consign to Memory provides card draw and disruption. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive and efficient creatures.

The deck focuses on using creatures with high mana costs and powerful abilities to control the game until the player can cast Living End to bring all creatures back from the graveyard, overwhelming the opponent with a strong board presence. The deck also includes cards that can disrupt opponents' strategies and protect its own creatures. By carefully managing resources and timing the Living End, the deck aims to quickly shift the game in its favor and secure a win.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly establish a strong board presence by utilizing efficient creatures like Guide of Souls, Ragavan, and Seasoned Pyromancer, while also utilizing direct damage spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to control the board and finish off opponents. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide additional threats and ways to push damage through. The deck also includes some protection with Static Prison and Thraben Charm to ensure the aggro strategy can continue uninterrupted.

The deck focuses on assembling a combo involving Allosaurus Rider and either Griselbrand or Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant to generate a massive amount of mana and cheat out powerful creatures early in the game. It aims to ramp up quickly using cards like Eldritch Evolution and Neoform to tutor for key pieces, while also utilizing cards like Consign to Memory and Nourishing Shoal for protection and lifegain. The deck also includes various utility cards like Pact of Negation and Boseiju, Who Endures to ensure the combo goes off smoothly and efficiently.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while quickly deploying threats on the board. By using cards like Thoughtseize and Relic of Progenitus to disrupt the opponent's hand and graveyard, combined with efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Solitude, it aims to control the game tempo. At the same time, it utilizes aggressive creatures like Ketramose, the New Dawn and Emperor of Bones to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. The addition of disruptive creatures like Flickerwisp and Witch Enchanter further adds to the deck's versatility and disruption capabilities.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption. It aims to control the game by countering key spells, removing threats, and disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize. The deck also utilizes creatures like Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus to apply pressure and win the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through attrition and strategic play.

The deck focuses on aggressive creatures that can quickly put pressure on the opponent, while also utilizing blink effects to protect its own creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By combining aggressive creatures like Emperor of Bones and Overlord of the Balemurk with blink effects like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck aims to control the battlefield and maintain a board presence. Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek help to disrupt the opponent's hand, while cards like Recruiter of the Guard and Witch Enchanter provide additional utility and card advantage.

This UB Mill deck focuses on using cards like Ruin Crab, Archive Trap, and Tasha's Hideous Laughter to quickly mill out opponents' decks and win the game by depleting their library. The deck also includes cards like Surgical Extraction and Drown in the Loch to disrupt opponent's strategies and protect against threats. By efficiently milling cards from the opponent's library, this deck aims to win the game by emptying the opponent's deck before they can assemble their win condition.
